name: Best Egg (personal loans)
notes: Researched from public support.bestegg.com articles (read through the help center's public article API; no sign-in). Online, borrowers make, schedule or cancel one-time payments on the Personal Loan dashboard Payments tab and enroll or edit auto pay there; the help center says to call 855-282-6353 or chat to modify or cancel auto pay, so autopay_cancel is unsupported online (the catalog note mentions an Edit option; the newer article was followed). Bi-weekly auto pay with a chosen amount exists (only monthly modelled). Payments after 7:00 pm ET post the next business day. Pay by text (PAYNOW to 28448), phone, chat and mail. No payment fees are mentioned (fees omitted; bank-only methods, inferred). Hardship options are shown after logging in or by phone/email (payment_arrangement not asserted). Sign-in identifier not documented (family default kept).

autopay.note: Auto pay withdraws your payment on the same day each month. Allow 1-3 business days for it to show in your bank account.

autopay_cancel.note: To change or cancel auto pay, call 855-282-6353 or chat with a loan specialist after logging in.

pay_by_phone.note: Call 855-282-6353 Monday-Thursday 8:00 am-10:00 pm, Friday 8:00 am-8:00 pm and Saturday 9:00 am-6:00 pm ET.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Log in any time to make, schedule or cancel a payment from the Payments tab of your Personal Loan dashboard. You can also call 855-282-6353, chat with a loan specialist, or text PAYNOW to 28448 to pay by text. Payments received after 7:00 pm ET post the next business day.
By mail, send a check, cashier's check or money order with your Best Egg account number to Best Egg Personal Loan, PO Box 207865, Dallas, TX 75320-7865, and allow 7-10 business days.

help.title: Auto pay
paragraphs: Auto pay takes your payment on the same day each month and posts it on your scheduled draft date. Enroll online from the Payments tab by choosing Auto Pay, or call 855-282-6353. Paying early does not cancel, skip or change the next auto pay draft.

Bi-weekly auto pay is available: choose Auto Pay, then Biweekly, and pick an amount and start date. Your full monthly payment must still be made by the due date. To change or cancel auto pay, call or chat with us; if a payment is returned, auto pay may be cancelled.
steps: Log in and open your Personal Loan dashboard.
Choose Auto Pay from the menu.
Pick the schedule and bank account, then confirm.

help.title: If you can't make a payment
paragraphs: Log in to see the options that may be available to you, call 855-282-6353, chat with a loan specialist, or email loan_assistance@mybestegg.com. If your payment is due in the next three days, call so the draft is not withdrawn.

extra.intent: Using Best Egg's help center, find the word you text (and the number) to start paying your loan by text. Do not make a payment.
